notes: Card: 'us' x6, 't' x6, 'ot' x3, 'onia' x2, 'ati' x2, 'ius' x2. Probes: 'onia' 1.044, 'is' 0.931, 'ati' 0.854; plain versions under 0.01. Tokens are checked. Near misses use ordinary words.
